subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir demonstrated remarkable composure, repeatedly deflecting the Medusa's deadly petrifying gaze by shoving an ice mirror in her face.
source_quote: Throughout the fight, Zalthir had demonstrated remarkable composure, repeatedly deflecting the creature's deadly petrifying gaze by shoving an ice mirror in her face.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz's magical missiles struck true and ended the creature's life.
source_quote: The final blow came from Daz, whose magical missiles struck true and ended the creature's life.

subject: five exquisite dresses made of spider silk and shaped by drow magic
fact: Five exquisite dresses made of spider silk and shaped by drow magic, worth a considerable fortune in the markets of the Underdark.
source_quote: the adventurers discovered five exquisite dresses made of spider silk and shaped by drow magic, worth a considerable fortune in the markets of the Underdark.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool expressed unusual delight at tasting the Medusa's remains, cheerfully noting that the party provided an excellent supply of dietary flavoring as he slowly cleaned up the aftermath of battle.
source_quote: Glabbagool, the intelligent gelatinous cube who traveled with them, expressed unusual delight at tasting the Medusa's remains, cheerfully noting that the party provided an excellent supply of dietary flavoring as he slowly cleaned up the aftermath of battle.

subject: ancient temple
fact: The party turned their attention to their true objective: hallowing the ancient temple to cleanse it of Ogrémoch's Bane, an evil force from the elemental plane of earth.
source_quote: With the Medusa defeated, the party turned their attention to their true objective: hallowing the ancient temple to cleanse it of Ogrémoch's Bane, an evil force from the elemental plane of earth.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum, as the party's cleric, volunteered to place the Ruby spell gem that Gerdig Katfinger had provided into the great menhir that stood in the temple's center.
source_quote: Grygum, as the party's cleric, volunteered to place the Ruby spell gem that Gerdig Katfinger had provided into the great menhir that stood in the temple's center.

subject: chamber
fact: The chamber itself was ominous, with rough walls that outlined several large, vaguely humanoid shapes.

subject: Earth Elemental

subject: Daz

subject: Zalthir

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum followed with a brilliant flash of divine light that struck the creature with tremendous force, reducing it to rubble.

subject: Galeb Duhr
fact: As the first elemental fell, a boulder-like creature with stumpy limbs materialized from the stone—a Galeb Duhr, an ancient stone guardian.
source_quote: As the first elemental fell, a boulder-like creature with stumpy limbs materialized from the stone—a Galeb Duhr, an ancient stone guardian.

subject: Galeb Duhr
fact: The Galeb Duhr revealed that Ogrémoch had infected the temple and prevented these guardians from performing their sacred duty to protect it.
source_quote: The Galeb Duhr revealed that Ogrémoch had infected the temple and prevented these guardians from performing their sacred duty to protect it.

subject: Earth Elemental
fact: Even as it spoke, another Earth Elemental emerged from the northern wall.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin engaged it directly with his glowing sword Dawnbringer.
source_quote: Thorin engaged it directly with his glowing sword Dawnbringer.

subject: Grygum

subject: Thorin

subject: Galeb Duhr
